# Security policy

Please report security vulnerabilities in SealCode privately, through
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/epitaphwastakenn/SealCode/security/advisories/new) on this
repository's Security tab. Do not open a public issue for them.

Include what is affected, how to reproduce it, and the impact you see. We will confirm receipt, investigate,
and coordinate a fix and disclosure with you.

Vulnerabilities in upstream [T3 Code](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code) itself should go to its maintainers,
following [its security policy](https://t3.codes/security-policy). Vulnerabilities in the Roqer harness go to
[Roqer](https://github.com/S4US/Roqer).
